digest.component_or_area: environment variable registry and ownership scripts
propositions: All 9 live KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS rows declare an empty prefix field, and the only historical prefixed row (_rebar_env with REBAR_) was removed by the RP-04 cutover
The prefix field is wired but unused in two CI gate scripts (_scan_call and _helper_access), creating a maintenance hazard with zero production users and zero honest coverage
Remove the prefix element from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS tuples in both consumers, simplifying the data structure from dict[str, tuple[int, str]] to dict[str, int]
Update tuple-destructuring code in _scan_call, _call_key_expr, _helper_access, and related test fixtures to read bare integers instead of subscripting on tuples
Verify that docs/env-vars.md regenerates byte-identical after the prefix removal, confirming no live row relied on prefixing
